preliminary.description: Any reviews left during an ongoing anime/manga, those reviews are tagged as preliminary. NOTE: Preliminary reviews are not returned by default so if the entry is airing/publishing you need to add this otherwise you will get an empty list. e.g usage: `?preliminary=true`

spoilers.description: Any reviews that are tagged as a spoiler. Spoiler reviews are not returned by default. e.g usage: `?spoiler=true`
